title: JWTweaks
description: Dimension-colored tab list with AFK tracking.
body:
## JWTweaks

Small mod that improves the player list (shown on Tab button press)

|Default|
|---|
|![default](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/97aabc0e86eb3b09f7870c1c58cf14e694096ff4.png)|

## Functions (can be changed via config)

The color of the player's name is associated with the dimension in which they are located:

- ![green](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0c582913770e351df08943affe9a3dc585426954.png) Green for Overworld
- ![red](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eb59faf79c3b704d696b57ec2ac5d3cf74ea5151.png) Red for Nether
- ![purple](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e2d64f1dc38ce281d6f8538958fe9d8045e22498.png) Purple for The End

## Usage
### Commands

``` /jwtweaks ``` - is the main mod command

|Command|Description|
|---|---|
|/jwtweaks reload|Reloading the plugin and configuration|

## Configuration

```
{
  "overworldColor": "GREEN",
  "netherColor": "RED",
  "endColor": "LIGHT_PURPLE",
  "otherColor": "WHITE",
  "afkBadgeColor": "GRAY",
  "afkBadgeText": " [⌚]"
}
```
## Reference
